change_reason: Correct the evaluation unit before any family-level promotion result exists; add frozen multiplicity, clustering and entry-semantics definitions without changing numeric promotion thresholds.

definitions.feature_cutoff: strictly_before_decision_timestamp; daily market context uses prior completed close

clustering.author_independence: unique author count within each rule family
clustering.bootstrap_block: ISO-week; resample whole weeks so cross-symbol market correlation stays together

multiple_testing.hypothesis_family: all testable rule_family x horizon combinations in one evaluation run
multiple_testing.pvalue_method: cluster sign-flip null on ISO-week block means

mae_noninferiority.pass_rule: observed mean direction-adjusted MAE >= unconditional benchmark mean direction-adjusted MAE

price_source_policy.conflict_policy: mark invalid/conflict and do not score

promotion_activation.reason: The statistical pipeline must pass synthetic positive, repeated negative and leakage-canary controls before family-level promotion can be treated as validated.
